module origen_100383(
    input wire clk,
    input wire reset,
    input wire resetRound,
    input wire L, U, D, R,
    input wire NL, NU, ND, NR,
    output reg lightOn
);

    // State definition
    localparam OFF = 1'b0;
    localparam ON = 1'b1;

    reg state, next_state;

    // State transition logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            OFF: begin
                if ((L && NR && !U && !D && !R) ||
                    (R && NL && !U && !D && !L) ||
                    (U && ND && !L && !D && !R) ||
                    (D && NU && !L && !U && !R))
                    next_state = ON;
                else
                    next_state = OFF;
            end
            ON: begin
                if ((L && !U && !D && !R) ||
                    (R && !U && !D && !L) ||
                    (U && !L && !D && !R) ||
                    (D && !L && !U && !R))
                    next_state = OFF;
                else
                    next_state = ON;
            end
            default: next_state = OFF;
        endcase
    end

    // State register
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset or posedge resetRound) begin
        if (reset || resetRound)
            state <= OFF;
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // Output logic
    always @(*) begin
        lightOn = (state == ON);
    end

endmodule
